name: smwmusic-the-legend-of-zelda-breath-of-the-wild-shrine-battle
title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild - Shrine Battle
description:
The battle music that plays when you fight a shrine guardian in Breath of the Wild.
It's got some odd time signatures, so it feels very tense and uneasy.
Would probably fit in boss fights or abstract levels.

NOTE: Not compatible with Thunder/Blargg, Bonus End, or Starman SFX/Global songs.
@7, @8, @17, @21, and Thunder are omitted.
